code.label: identity.industry.naics
code.why: NAICS codes of two to six digits and the three sector ranges. Inferred, the share of two- and three-digit codes in the sample can move the label; nominated so it stays the NAICS type the table has carried since it was first published.

code_display.label: identity.industry.naics
code_display.why: The same values as code, nominated with it.

parent_code.label: identity.industry.naics
parent_code.why: A NAICS code one level up, two to five characters, nominated with code.

description.label: representation.text.plain_text
description.why: Census's title for the code, such as Soybean Farming: free text, labelled as the other code lists label their descriptions. Inferred, finetype can read short titles as words or names.

description_full.label: representation.text.plain_text
description_full.why: The title in context, its ancestors' titles first, labelled with description.

release.label: representation.identifier.alphanumeric_id
release.why: The NAICS edition, 2022, stored as text as every code list's release is. Inferred, finetype reads the four digits as a year; the value names an edition, not a point in time.

text_source.label: representation.text.word
text_source.why: Whose text description is, always census: a closed set of one word, as the other code lists label it.

corpus.label: representation.text.plain_text
corpus.why: The lowered, accent-stripped description_full the search reads, labelled with it.

title.label: representation.text.plain_text
title.why: Census's title, the same values as description, kept under the name the table published before the contract; nominated so it keeps the label it was published with.

definition.label: representation.text.plain_text
definition.why: Census's paragraph defining the industry, free text, NULL where Census gives none. Inferred, finetype labelled this text `unknown` when it was the description column, and an `unknown` field publishes no length bounds.

sector_code.label: identity.industry.naics
sector_code.why: The sector's NAICS code, two digits or a range, nominated with code.

subsector_code.label: identity.industry.naics
subsector_code.why: The subsector's three-digit NAICS code, nominated with code.

industry_group_code.label: identity.industry.naics
industry_group_code.why: The industry group's four-digit NAICS code, nominated with code.

naics_industry_code.label: identity.industry.naics
naics_industry_code.why: The NAICS industry's five-digit code, nominated with code.
